thought.text: All validation checks are complete. I have comprehensive evidence of a working installation.

reasoning_content:
All checks completed. Summary of evidence:

1. **Prerequisites**: PHP 8.4.26 (the guide permits "8.3, 8.4 or higher" via Herd isolate, and composer.lock requires >=8.4), Composer 2.10.3, Node v22.23.3, npm 10.9.9, all required PHP extensions (sqlite3, mbstring, xml, curl, fileinfo) are present.

2. **Installation artifacts**: vendor/ (138 packages via composer install), node_modules, .env with APP_KEY, database/database.sqlite with 9 migrated tables (migrate:status all "Ran").

3. **Running services** (from composer dev): php artisan serve (:8000), queue:listen, pail, vite (:5173) — all confirmed running via ps.

4. **App behavior**:
   - GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/ → HTTP 200, Inertia page "MainPage", name "Interaktive Gartenkarte", props include sensorMarkers (37 markers) and rootNavElements — the interactive garden map is being served.
   - Vite serves app.ts, MainPage.vue, @vite/client, and all 6 subcomponents with 200.
   - /up → 200 (health check).
   - /api/home-info-card-text → 200 with welcome HTML.
   - Live sensor data: GET /api/sensors/wetterstation/data → 200, actual live values from opendata.wuerzburg.de (Lufttemperatur: 10.6 °C, Luftfeuchte: 93.4 %, Niederschlag 4 mm, Sonnenstrahlung 98 W/m²). This confirms end-to-end live sensor data flow — the core function of the software.
   - External opendata.wuerzburg.de is reachable (302).

5. **Known upstream defects**: UserInfo.vue and UserMenuContent.vue are missing from the git tree (verified with git ls-tree → empty, files don't exist). Only reachable via NavUser.vue → AppSidebar.vue/AppHeader.vue → layouts → Dashboard.vue, and Dashboard.vue has no route (the only defined app route is GET /). MainPage.vue (the page provided by the sole route) has a fully intact import graph, and all modules resolve with 200 on Vite. Therefore the primary application works per the guide. npm run build (production) will fail, but the guide's dev setup (composer dev) works.

Assessment: The guide's "Lokales Dev-Setup" is complete, and the application is operational as described — available at http://localhost:8000 with Vite at 5173, live sensor data working. The missing Vue components are an upstream source defect, not an installation gap; they don't affect the sole routed page (MainPage). Per the outcome definition, success requires that the installation be complete and the software be operational per the guide. All steps of the guide were executed, and the app operates as described.

Is the missing-component issue a failure? The installation guide is the standard of judgment: "Die Anwendung ist dann unter http://localhost:8000 erreichbar. Frontend-Assets werden von Vite (http://localhost:5173) bereitgestellt und automatisch eingebunden." That is exactly the state that has been confirmed. The missing files are not installed by any step of the guide — they simply don't exist in the repository commit (shallow clone at 7edb795 = main). The installer could not have installed files that don't exist in the source repository. The primary functionality (interactive garden map with live LoRaWAN data) has been demonstrated to work end-to-end.

The production deployment path (npm run build) fails, but that is an alternative deployment method, and the installed configuration is the dev setup which the guide lists first and which is what was executed. "Missing files required only for another installation method do not constitute a failure." — the production build is an alternative installation/deployment method. The installed dev setup works completely.

Also regarding PHP version: the guide states a minimum of PHP 8.2, and the installer used 8.4. composer.lock requires >=8.4 for some symfony packages, so 8.4 is the only workable choice within the scope of the guide's own Herd section, which permits "8.3, 8.4 oder höher". No issue.

Assessed outcome: success.

Evidence list:
1. `php -v` → PHP 8.4.26; `composer --version` → 2.10.3; `node -v` → v22.23.3; `npm -v` → 10.9.9; `php -m` lists curl, fileinfo, mbstring, sqlite3, xml.
2. ps aux → concurrently running with php artisan serve (PID 17467), queue:listen (17469), pail (17471), vite node (17485).
3. `curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/` → HTTP 200, 81902 bytes, Inertia data-page component "MainPage", props sensorMarkers list len=37, name "Interaktive Gartenkarte"; references http://127.0.0.1:5173/@vite/client, app.ts, MainPage.vue.
4. Vite 200 for app.ts, MainPage.vue, @vite/client, and 6 subcomponents.
5. `php artisan migrate:status` → all 3 migration files "Ran"; sqlite tables: users, password_reset_tokens, sessions, cache, cache_locks, jobs, job_batches, failed_jobs, migrations.
6. .env: APP_KEY=base64:..., APP_URL=http://localhost:8000, DB_CONNECTION=sqlite.
7. `curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/sensors/wetterstation/data` → HTTP 200 in 0.3s, live values "Lufttemperatur: 10.6 °C, Luftfeuchte: 93.4 %, Niederschlag 4 mm, Sonnenstrahlung 98 W/m²" — end-to-end live LoRaWAN data from opendata.wuerzburg.de.
8. `curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/home-info-card-text` → 200 with garden welcome text.
9. `curl http://localhost:8000/up` → 200.
10. Confirmed missing upstream files: `git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only | grep -iE 'UserInfo|UserMenuContent'` → empty (exit 1); files absent from disk; only reachable from Dashboard.vue (no route).

Limitations: no browser-based JS runtime rendering (module graph verified via curl against Vite); npm run build fails due to upstream-missing components (only affects production deployment path, does not affect dev setup); ss/netstat unavailable (exit 1) but port checks done via curl.

I'm confident in success.

action.message: Validation complete: the Interaktive Gartenkarte dev installation is complete and operational. All guide steps verified (PHP 8.4 + extensions, Composer 2.10.3, Node 22, vendor/node_modules present, .env with APP_KEY, SQLite migrated, composer dev stack running). The app serves HTTP 200 at http://localhost:8000 with the Inertia MainPage carrying 37 sensor markers; Vite (:5173) serves every module in MainPage's import graph; and live LoRaWAN sensor data flows end-to-end from opendata.wuerzburg.de (wetterstation endpoint returned real current readings). The two missing Vue components are an upstream source defect confined to the unrouted Dashboard.vue layout chain and do not affect the routed main application page.
